dict.string: To complete necessary security checks, Emote Cash requires camera authorization. Captured content is used only for verification and handled according to applicable rules.
We hope to use contacts to strengthen the security level of financial services. Your privacy will be fully protected. This information is used only for account security-related purposes.
Emote Cash needs temporary precise location to read the current Wi-Fi network name for device security verification. This access is used only during verification and is not retained.

To provide appropriate loan amounts based on different regions, Emote Cash would like to obtain location permission. We will strictly protect your location privacy. This information is used only to recommend suitable products and will not be retained after processing.

Emote Cash hopes to obtain your IDFA authorization to provide you with more accurate personalized loan recommendation services. This will help us better understand your preferences and continuously optimize the product experience. Your information is used only for internal optimization and will not be permanently stored or shared with third parties.
